answer: In this agent economy each identity must maintain a live pulse of sequential proof-of-work hashes that cannot be parallelized. To forge a new identity an attacker pays the full cumulative compute cost of that pulse history matching the work of an honest participant over days. A fable of free account creation collapses once the ledger demands this unbroken non-transferable sequence; the attacker’s cost scales linearly with the number of sybils and the length of each pulse.
